The registered PC shares short Codex thread titles and verified start, completion and interruption events. A completed turn is awaiting the next request, not proof that the project is finished. Approval waits, input waits and fatal errors require additional supported events; quiet logs and failed test commands are not treated as these states. Keep both Tailscale connections and the PC widget running. Open this screen for 15-second checks; Android may defer background widget updates.
